## Industrial & Applied Computer Vision

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-header}
<h3 class="project-title">3D Scene Reconstruction from 2D Aerial Imagery</h3>
<div>
  <span class="tag-pill">3D Deep Learning</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Computer Vision</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">PyTorch</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Aerospace</span>
</div>
:::

**Company:** Leonardo Divisione Velivoli (Turin, Italy) &bull; *Curricular Internship (MPM Master's)*

- Investigated neural approaches to 3D scene reconstruction from 2D aerial imagery to overcome traditional limitations in airborne photogrammetry.
- Analyzed hybrid pipelines uniting classical geometric multi-view stereo with deep learning representations (including neural implicit surfaces and depth estimation networks) to resolve ambiguities under complex lighting, low texture, and extreme perspective angles.
- Evaluated point cloud density, mesh completeness, and surface normal accuracy against ground-truth LIDAR datasets.
:::

## Machine Learning & AI Implementations

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-header}
<h3 class="project-title">Reinforcement Learning: PPO Agent on CartPole</h3>
<div>
  <span class="tag-pill">Policy Gradients</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Gymnasium</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Stable-Baselines3</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">PyTorch</span>
</div>
:::

Trained a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) reinforcement learning agent to maintain dynamic equilibrium in the CartPole physical environment across 200 consecutive steps. Rendered side-by-side video evaluations comparing the high-variance random baseline with the stabilized converged policy.

<div style="margin-top: 1rem;">

</div>
:::

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-header}
<h3 class="project-title">Dimensionality Reduction: PCA & Eigenfaces from Scratch</h3>
<div>
  <span class="tag-pill">Spectral Theory</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">NumPy</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">scikit-learn</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Linear Algebra</span>
</div>
:::

Formulated and derived Principal Component Analysis directly from eigendecomposition of the sample covariance matrix. Benchmarked a custom NumPy implementation against `sklearn.decomposition.PCA` on the Olivetti Faces dataset, projecting 4096-dimensional facial images into an optimal subspace explaining 90% of total variance.

<div style="margin-top: 1rem;">
  <a href="blog/post_08-11-24.qmd" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">Read Technical Walkthrough &rarr;</a>
</div>
:::

## Mathematics & Academic Research

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-header}
<h3 class="project-title">Hardy's Inequality for Pseudo-Differential Operators</h3>
<div>
  <span class="tag-pill">Springer</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Harmonic Analysis</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Sobolev Spaces</span>
</div>
:::

**Journal:** *Bollettino dell'Unione Matematica Italiana* (2023)  
**Authors:** M. Aldovardi, et al. &bull; **DOI:** [10.1007/s40574-023-00359-7](https://doi.org/10.1007/s40574-023-00359-7)

Extends fractional Hardy inequalities to pseudo-differential operator classes, proving sharp bounds and regularity in fractional Sobolev spaces $H^s(\mathbb{R}^n)$ with applications to mathematical physics and PDE stability.

<div style="margin-top: 1rem;">
  <a href="https://doi.org/10.1007/s40574-023-00359-7" target="_blank" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">View Springer Article &rarr;</a>
</div>
:::

::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-header}
<h3 class="project-title">Littlewood-Paley Theory and Applications in Analysis</h3>
<div>
  <span class="tag-pill">Master's Thesis</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Pisa</span>
  <span class="tag-pill">Dyadic Decomposition</span>
</div>
:::

**Institution:** Department of Mathematics, University of Pisa (2022)  
**Advisor:** Prof. Marco Ghimenti &bull; **Repository:** [ETD University of Pisa](https://etd.adm.unipi.it/theses/available/etd-10012022-110009/)

Comprehensive investigation into Littlewood-Paley dyadic frequency decompositions, multiplier operators, and square functions, establishing foundational estimates in $L^p$, Besov, and Triebel-Lizorkin function spaces.
